question.text: Which of the following actions is included in what a Regulated Entity must do if it is unable to conduct or complete CDD for a customer?

answer.text: Not open an account, not carry out transactions, not establish a business relationship, and consider filing an STR
Proceed with limited services while completing CDD gradually
Inform the customer about the deficiency and ask them to self-certify
Seek a waiver from IFSCA for that particular customer

explanation.text: The Logic: When CDD cannot be completed, the RE must not open an account, not carry out transactions, and not establish a business relationship. The RE must also terminate or suspend any existing relationship, return monies/assets received, and consider whether the failure requires filing an STR. The Trap: Offering limited services, relying on customer self-certification, or applying for a per-customer waiver are not permitted alternatives. Note: The full action set also includes terminating existing relationships and returning monies received.
